name: @playliquid/platform-social
description: PlayLiquid GameOS social graph service (PL-015). Follow/block relation read model with tenant-scoped queries, negative paths (block beats follow, self-follow refused) and event-sourced admission over @playliquid/platform-contracts (SocialServicePolicy, adjudicateSocialAction, SocialActionRequest/SocialRelation shapes) with game-ir canonical event evidence (@playliquid/game-ir GameEvent hashing and value guards). Pure domain: the service instance is the single mutable-state owner; persistence, time, subject directory and grants live behind ports with in-memory fakes; no IO, no timers, no globals.
